name: benzocaine + levomenthol
purpose: Active ingredients Purpose Benzocaine 20% Topical analgesic Menthol 0.5% Topical analgesic
uses: Uses for temporary relief of pain and itching associated with sunburn insect bites minor cuts scrapes minor burns minor skin irritations
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens or symptoms persist for more than 7 days symptoms clear up and occur again within a few days itching, rash or irritation develops
